entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand sensor and I need to do it now. Your website is a joke and this whole process is ridiculous.
I can certainly look into that return for you. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. Could I get your full name and order number, please?
It's David Miller, order number 772-V-901. And don't give me the runaround, I want a refund, not store credit or some other nonsense.

I understand you're frustrated, Mr. Miller. I've pulled up your account. I see you received the VeloBand on December 15th. To make sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

The issue is that I couldn't return it because I was in the HOSPITAL! I had an emergency surgery, okay? I wasn't exactly worried about your return window while I was recovering. Now your system is blocking me. This is unbelievable customer service. Get me a manager right now!

Sir, there's no need for a manager, I can absolutely handle this for you. I completely understand. An unexpected medical emergency like that is a serious matter. Let me just take a moment to review our official policy for this situation.
You'd better. I'm one click away from telling everyone I know how VeloFit treats customers who have a life-threatening emergency.

I understand. Please hold for just one moment... (typing sounds) ... Okay, Mr. Miller, thanks for your patience. I've checked our policy, and you have absolutely nothing to worry about. You are well within the return period.
What? The email I got said 10 days. Are you sure?

Yes, I am looking at our knowledge base right now. All VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You are only on day 17. I apologize for any confusing information you may have received. It might have been for a different type of product.
Oh. Ninety days. Well, alright then. So you can process the refund?

Absolutely. I've just initiated that for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file. Simply pack the VeloBand back in its box, apply the label, and drop it off at the post office. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued to your card.
Okay. That's... actually helpful. Thank you. Sorry for yelling, it's been a rough couple of weeks after the surgery.
Not a problem at all, Mr. Miller. We completely understand. We hope your recovery is a smooth one. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a great day.
